nodes.name: Ask NEXUS To Route And Record
nodes.notes: SAFE to retry: nexus_request_send is keyed on (tenant_id, request_ref) and a repeat returns ALREADY_ROUTED_UNDER_THIS_REQUEST_REF rather than routing twice. It writes the directive row -- including every refusal -- before any transport runs. If this call fails, nothing was sent and nothing is claimed.

nodes.name: POST Graph Messages
nodes.notes: retryOnFail is FALSE on purpose. The Graph messages endpoint has no idempotency key: an n8n-level retry of a request the server already accepted is a second message to a real customer. neverError + fullResponse means a 4xx arrives as DATA and is classified below rather than vanishing; the error output catches only the case where the call never completed at all. Token: META_WA_SYSTEM_USER_TOKEN -- NOT META_PAGE_ACCESS_TOKEN, which in this repo holds the Lead Ads Page token (scope leads_retrieval) and cannot send a message.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ p_directive_id: $json.directive_id, p_result: $json.result, p_provider_message_id: $json.provider_message_id, p_error_code: $json.error_code, p_error_detail: $json.error_detail }) }}

nodes.name: Record Send Result
nodes.notes: SAFE to retry, and it must be: this is the durable row for BOTH outcomes. nexus_record_send_result returns ALREADY_RECORDED for an identical repeat and raises 55000 on a CONFLICTING second result rather than overwriting. It is deliberately not onError:continue -- a send whose outcome we failed to write down is an incident, and the execution should stay red until someone reconciles it.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ outcome: $('Classify Provider Response').item.json.result, directive_id: $('Classify Provider Response').item.json.directive_id, wamid: $('Classify Provider Response').item.json.provider_message_id, error_code: $('Classify Provider Response').item.json.error_code, note: 'Accepted is not delivered and is not read. No screen may say otherwise until a delivery-event feed exists.' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ outcome: 'DO_NOT_SEND', directive_id: $json.directive_id, reason_code: $json.result.reason_code, reason: $json.result.reason, what_would_change_it: $json.result.what_would_change_it, policy_window_state: $json.result.policy_window_state, template_category_required: $json.result.template_category_required, recorded: $json.ledger_state, note: 'This refusal is durable. nexus_request_send filed it in channel_send_directive with send_result NOT_ATTEMPTED before any transport ran.' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ outcome: 'NOT_SENT', reason_code: $json.reason_code, why: $json.why, wrote_nothing: true }) }}

This is a NEXUS availability failure, not a refusal, and it must not be reported to a salesperson as "the customer cannot be messaged".', wrote_nothing: true }) }}
